name: SheepMsg
meaning: msgIds handled by Sheep_HandleMessage (senders found by corpus grep)

name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: Wolf/Sam: returns 2 (grabbable) if state flags&0x320==0 and height within -50..+80

name: MSG_PICKUP
meaning: arg=joint; by Wolf(0)/Sam(1)/Crane(0x52); alerted in-zone sheep refuse Wolf -> state 0x1B

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: arg = {Vec3s pos; u16 flags(bit1 = keep pos)} -> FALL / FROZEN_FALL

name: MSG_LAUNCH
meaning: tossed by the bull (0x42f7a1, arg 0) or launched by a seesaw (0x4ef3cb, arg LaunchArc*); SensibleButton never sends it

name: MSG_SEESAW_DRIFT
meaning: idle only: fallTime 0x800, slope limit off 500 ms, FALL

name: MSG_GEYSER_IN
meaning: out-of-zone sheep only; 0x28 / 0x2A; returns anim length or 2000

name: MSG_TIMEMACHINE_SWAP
meaning: in-zone sheep teleports home, snap, idle

name: MSG_QUERY_MOVING
meaning: 1 if state 0x20 else 2 -- the same in-flight query the seesaw sends at 0x4eef29 (not a button query)

name: MSG_SHEEP_CALL
meaning: Wolf state 0x8C broadcast r=800: follow (0x1D) or stop following
